'''Chris Terwilliger''' (Players Committee forum name Chris Twigg; X '''LittleTwigg''') is a core member of [[Team Albany]]. At [[DecipherCon 2000]] he won the four-player team championship with [[Matt Sokol]], [[Jonny Chu]] and [[Brian Terwilliger]].<ref name="eltwigg">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1327604566830043142 Brian Terwilliger], X (14 November 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201114133100/https://twitter.com/eltwigg/status/1327604566830043142 Wayback Machine]; [https://archive.ph/Hm5mO archive.today].</ref> He also reached the Top 8 of the [[2014 World Championship]] and played Players Committee events in 2025.<ref name="pc-2025">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-02-morristown-melee-morristown-new-jersey-apr-24-27-2025/ 2025 Morristown Melee], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014140457/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2025-02-morristown-melee-morristown-new-jersey-apr-24-27-2025.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[File:Chris Terwilliger DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Chris Terwilliger at [[DecipherCon 2000]]]]

He is the brother of [[Brian Terwilliger]]. He bought Brian his first [[Princess Leia]] from [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]], snuck it into Brian's Light mains deck, and dealt Brian a starting hand with her waiting.<ref name="leia">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1417764733378187270 Brian Terwilliger], X (21 July 2021). "My brother bought me my first Princess Leia from this set, snuck it into my light side mains deck, demanded we play at 11pm and dealt my starting hand where she was waiting for me. Won't ever forget this @LittleTwigg. Best Swccg bros 4 life." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210721083400/https://twitter.com/eltwigg/status/1417764733378187270 Wayback Machine].</ref>
